claim: Victor's Fine Dining address is Schloßstraße 27–29, 66706 Perl-Nennig, inside Victor's Residenz-Hotel Schloss Berg.
quote: Schloßstraße 27–29 · 66706 Perl-Nennig · Germany. The restaurant is located in the VICTOR'S RESIDENZ-HOTEL SCHLOSS BERG.

claim: Hôtel Château Schengen reopened in June 2024 as a renovated historic château hotel in Schengen, Luxembourg.
quote: Carefully renovated and reopened since June 1, 2024, the Hôtel Château Schengen blends history, contemporary elegance, and leisurely living.

claim: Schloss Saareck is a 1902–03 castle on the Saar in Mettlach, the guest house of Villeroy & Boch AG since 1954, with 22 rooms and suites in heritage interiors.
quote: Originally a family residence for the von Boch family... has served as a Villeroy & Boch AG guest house since 1954... 22 rooms and suites decorated with high-quality fabrics and atmospheric tones.

claim: The Saarschleifenlodge in Mettlach-Dreisbach is an eco-certified property offering lofts, suites, tiny houses and tree houses.
quote: lofts, suites, tiny houses and tree houses for a unique stay surrounded by nature... ecologically certified.

claim: Domaine la Forêt is a 4-star Remich hotel with 16 rooms, a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide, and a 700 m² spa.
quote: Domaine la Forêt is a 4-star hotel with 16 rooms, nestled between vineyards and woodland, featuring a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide and a 700 m² spa.

claim: Hotel Villa Hügel Trier is a 4-star superior boutique hotel in a 1914 Jugendstil villa, 45 rooms plus a separate adults-only Relax wing with rooftop pool.
quote: Jugendstil (Art Nouveau) villa, built in 1914 as a wine merchant's residence... 45 rooms, plus a separate Relax area with 15 additional comfort rooms and suites (adults-only section with rooftop pool).

claim: Victor's Fine Dining serves Thursday–Sunday dinner and Saturday–Sunday lunch, with creative-pause closures 18 May–7 Jun and 21 Sep–4 Oct 2026; Christian Bau has held 3 Michelin stars since 2005.
quote: Dinner: Thursday–Sunday, 7 p.m.–midnight... Closed: Monday–Wednesday. Creative breaks in 2026: May 18–June 7 and September 21–October 4. 3 Michelin stars since 2005.

claim: From Nennig to Saarburg is roughly 19 km / 18 minutes by road; taxi runs about €55–70 one-way.
quote: The distance over roads between Nennig and Saarburg is 12 miles (approximately 19 km). It takes approximately 18 minutes to drive... the fastest connection from Nennig to Saarburg by taxi costs $55-$70 and takes 18 minutes.

claim: Victor's Residenz-Hotel Schloss Berg is listed in the MICHELIN Guide hotels collection.
quote: Victor's Residenz - Hotel Schloss Berg - Nennig - Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel.

claim: Schloss Berg has 106 rooms and suites combining a Mediterranean villa and a Renaissance castle.
quote: There are 106 guest rooms and suites with en-suite bathroom... 5-star hotel in Perl, Germany with a Mediterranean villa and a small Renaissance castle.

claim: Château Schengen has 17 rooms and suites with 13 more planned, and a restaurant spanning four historic rooms seating up to 180 covers; taken over in 2024 by the JBM group under Jean-Baptiste Marx.
quote: The hotel offers 17 rooms and suites... 13 additional rooms were planned to expand the offering. The château's restaurant spans four distinct rooms, accommodating up to 180 covers.

claim: The Lohengrin restaurant at Hotel Saint-Nicolas Remich serves refined French cuisine with a prize-winning sommelier and panoramic Mosel views.
quote: Serving refined French cuisine, the Lohengrin restaurant has a prize-winning sommelier and offers panoramic views of the river.

claim: Guests describe Saarschleifenlodge tree-house apartments as functionally furnished with everything needed, rather than luxurious.
quote: Recent guests have praised their stays in the tree houses, noting that the apartments are functionally furnished and offer everything needed for exploring the beautiful Saarschleife.

claim: Hotel Villa Keller Saarburg is an 11-room riverside boutique with castle views, room rates roughly $200–235.
quote: 11 rooms with a balcony... picturesque riverside setting... stunning vistas of the Saar River and nearby castle... Room deals are available between $200 and $235 a night.

claim: Becker's Hotel & Restaurant Trier-Olewig is a 4-star design hotel combining a modern wing with a historic wine house; runs its own vineyard and two restaurants.
quote: Exclusive 4-star hotel in the Moselle region of Trier... wood, stone and linear design... two restaurant concepts: the BECKERS Restaurant serving fine cuisine and the traditional BECKERS wine house. The hotel operates its own vineyard.

claim: Schloss Berg villa rooms feature gilded headboards and Roman-antiquity-inspired art; castle rooms have ornate mirrors and canopied beds.
quote: Rooms in the villa feature sumptuous drapery, gilded headboards, richly carpeted floors in bold shades and artwork inspired by Roman antiquities. Those in the castle have a fairy tale aesthetic, with ornate mirrors and jewel-toned canopies over the beds.

claim: Recent reviews of Schloss Berg flag dated furnishings, lack of central air conditioning, and minor wear, but praise the breakfast.
quote: Many reviews indicate that room decor and furnishings are somewhat outdated or weary... absence of central air conditioning, relying instead on noisy portable units. However, the breakfast buffet receives widespread praise.

claim: Château de Schengen dates from 1390, was rebuilt as a manor in 1812 by Jean-Nicolas Colart; Victor Hugo sketched the old tower in 1871.
quote: The château dates from 1390 but was almost entirely rebuilt in the 19th century. The 14th-century fortress was demolished by industrialist Jean-Nicolas Colart in 1812 to construct a residential manor in its place. Victor Hugo visited the manor in 1871 and sketched the old tower.

claim: Domaine la Forêt offers rooms ranging from standard doubles around €150 up to duplex suites with private terraces and Jacuzzis.
quote: Options range from standard rooms (starting €150) to luxury duplex suites with private terraces and Jacuzzis.

claim: Driving distance Mettlach to Nennig is about 14.5 km / ~12 minutes.
quote: The driving distance between Ortsmitte B406, Tünsdorf Mettlach to Nennig is 9 miles, which converts to approximately 14.5 kilometers. It takes approximately 12 min to drive.

claim: Driving distance Perl to Trier is approximately 48.6 km / 45 minutes.
quote: Driving Distance: 48.6 km (approximately 30.2 miles). Driving Time: 45 minutes.
